Images · 100% Private Client-Side

Photo Duplicate Finder

Find exact duplicate image files using browser-side SHA-256 cryptographic hashing. Zero server uploads — all processing happens directly in your browser.

What it does

Scans batches of digital image files and identifies bit-for-bit duplicate copies using pre-filtered file size grouping and cryptographic SHA-256 binary hashing. Helps photographers and collectors reclaim disk space by finding redundant photo copies quickly and securely.

How to use

  1. Select multiple image files or drop an entire photo folder from your hard drive.
  2. The browser engine groups matching file sizes and hashes binary data using the SubtleCrypto API.
  3. Review the duplicate report showing exact duplicate groupings and file names.
  4. Use the findings to clean up redundant duplicate copies from your local storage.

Limits & Considerations

Identifies byte-for-byte exact duplicate files. Does not detect perceptual similarities between differently compressed or resized versions.

Privacy & Security

Binary cryptographic hashing executes purely on your device CPU using Web Cryptography. Zero image bytes leave your machine.
